lessons.title: Money

explanation_sections.title: Money
explanation_sections.body:
Financial calculations may include prices, budgets, discounts, profit and loss. The exact subtopic
sequence should be checked against the complete revised Grade 9 design.

lessons.source_reference: ElimuQuest Mathematics Curriculum Draft v1, PDF p. 13
lessons.author: ElimuQuest

questions.prompt: An item costs a shop KSh 1,200 and is sold for KSh 1,500. Find profit.
A phone costs KSh 20,000 and is discounted by 10%. Find the sale price.
A learner saves KSh 500 weekly for 12 weeks. Find total savings.
